thread:
sophia: Quick update — we just got a signed PoC with Snowflake + Databricks + Qdrant (vector DB) for a joint on‑prem + marketplace bundle. Need to coordinate press, marketplace listing, SI handoff, and an internal launch checklist. Who can drive announcement comms?

matt: Congrats! I can take announcement copy. When's the target date for public mention? :tada:

sophia: Targeting a soft announce after PoC kickoff (tentatively 2026-05-12). Legal asked for a 7‑day embargo around any joint logos/quotes. Also want a marketplace listing ready within 2 weeks of announce.

raj: From infra/connector side — we need to lock connector release (redwood-snow-dbx-vector v0.9.1) and a stable onprem bundle image tag. I’ll open a release branch today. Short checklist: schema compatibility tests, vector index mapping docs, and telemetry opt‑in for customers.

emily: I’ll own marketplace submission. Need the listing assets: 1‑pager, architecture diagram, supported region list, pricing blurb, and an approved logo. Can someone drop the approved legal copy for partner names?

sophia: @emily uploading assets to the shared drive in a bit. Legal copy: "Joint PoC with Snowflake, Databricks, and Qdrant" — Dana, can you confirm? Also confirm whether Snowflake wants co‑branded logo locked.

dana: Confirmed. Legal is OK with that phrasing. Snowflake asked for co‑branded logo usage guidelines — will get the guidelines doc from partner ops and post.

matt: Draft headline options (quick):
- "Redwood + Snowflake + Databricks + Qdrant: POC for enterprise vector search on private infra"
- "Joint PoC: Low‑latency vector search with Redwood in Snow/DBX environments"
Pick one and I’ll draft body.

raj: Technical note for the PoC runbook: include this test query sample so partners can reproduce perf numbers:

```
SELECT r.embedding FROM redwood_vectors rv
JOIN snowflake_table s ON s.id = rv.source_id
WHERE rv.embedding <-> q_embedding < 0.12
LIMIT 10;
```

Also add KV cache warmup step and batch_size defaults: batch_size=32, kv_cache_prefill=1000.

emily: Good — I'll add the SQL example to the marketplace listing and the PoC quickstart. For the marketplace, we also need an exact support SLA paragraph — who owns support for the PoC? Dedicated partners or Redwood support?

sophia: For PoC we offer joint support: Redwood handles runtime and connector patches; partner SIs handle customer onboarding. We'll document escalation matrix.

dana: I'll draft the escalation matrix. Also pinged partner_ops_bot to request partner logo assets and CI badges from Snow/DBX/Qdrant teams.

partner_ops_bot: Requested assets from partners. ETA 48 hours. Reply with a thread when assets arrive.

matt: Plan for announcement timeline:
- 2026-05-05: finalize assets & legal signoff
- 2026-05-08: marketplace submission
- 2026-05-10: internal readout + press preview
- 2026-05-12: soft announce (partners agree)

sophia: That timeline works. Raj — can you get the release branch and a test image by EOD tomorrow?

raj: Yep. Branch created: release/poс-onprem-1981 (pushed). I’ll post the image tag once CI finishes.

emily: Once logos and copy are in, I’ll draft the marketplace listing and send a preview to the partners for signoff.

dana: Legal will review final copy by 5/5. Tag me if anything changes.

sophia: Thanks team — I’ll run a sync Wed 10am PT to walk through the launch playbook and assign handoffs. Agenda: comms, marketplace ops, SI onboarding, support matrix, and PoC test plan. :white_check_mark:

matt: See you then. I’ll bring the draft press copy.

raj: Preparing perf numbers and test scripts.

emily: Will share listing draft before EOD Friday.

partner_ops_bot: Reminder scheduled: sync meeting 2026-04-29 10:00 PT.
